title: Add a task and return focus to the title field
description: Verifies that a user can create a task with a title and due date, see it appear in the list, and have focus return to the title field afterward.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Fill in the task title with a unique task name
Fill a valid due date into the due date field
Submit the form
Verify the new task appears in the task list
Verify focus returns to the task title field

Submit the task form

Verify focus returns to the task title field
